issues.title: Adopt MapContainer
issues.body:
We're currently creating the map using `react-leaflet` `Map` control.  But, if we use `MapContainer` then we will be able to use `useMap()` hook in child components.

Plus, if we pass `children` into the map control using props, then we can create functionality outside the map container class.

So, step-1 is to switch `SupportMapping` to use `MapContainer`.

Step-2 is to move `SupportMapping` to `Map` - and remove any functionality that is specific to `PlanningChannel`.  To do this, we'll have to pass the two `LayerGroup` components in as `children`.
